purpose: Pinned real-code projects for the graph/taint validation programme (PRD sections 8.3 and 8.4). These are DATA: the projects are analysed statically; nothing is built or executed.
acquiredBy: bench/dag/acquire.mjs (git fetch --depth 1 of the pinned commit; HEAD is verified equal to the pin)

toolchain.ghc: 9.14.1 (present on the acquisition host, NOT used: no Haskell project is compiled)
toolchain.cabal: 3.18.1.0 (present on the acquisition host, NOT used)
toolchain.nix: not installed on the acquisition host; Nix files are parsed statically, never evaluated
toolchain.note: The scanner is the only tool that reads these trees. The pins below, not the host toolchain, define the input.

projects.role: JS/TS HTTP server framework with a large examples/ tree of small apps
projects.buildConfig: package.json engines.node >= 18; no build step, no install performed

scanRoots.why: 70-file corpus of runnable server apps: the natural source of HTTP sources and response/redirect/download sinks

projects.excluded: test/, benchmarks/, docs and CI files: tests intentionally exercise bad input; they would dominate findings without representing application code

projects.role: JS/TS HTTP server framework with TypeScript type tests and examples
projects.buildConfig: package.json; no build step, no install performed
projects.excluded: test/, types/, docs/, build/, benchmark/ (benchmark/ is not under a scan root), and CI files

projects.versionAtPin: see scotty.cabal at the pinned commit (0.30 line)

projects.role: Haskell web framework monorepo (library packages, TemplateHaskell routing)
projects.buildConfig: stack.yaml resolver lts-23.10, cabal.project; not built

projects.excluded: yesod-bin, yesod-test, yesod-static, yesod-persistent, yesod-sitemap, yesod-newsfeed, yesod-eventsource, yesod-websockets, yesod-auth-oauth, yesod-form-multi, demo/

projects.versionAtPin: see release.json at the pinned commit
projects.buildConfig: flake.nix/default.nix; never evaluated (no nix on host); static parse only

scanRoots.why: user-level service modules: scripts, secrets and systemd units (218 files)

projects.excluded: modules/programs, modules/misc (635 files, option plumbing, 30s scan with 6 findings), modules/files, tests/, docs/, lib/, nix-darwin/, nixos/ (module glue)

projects.role: NixOS system module subset (bounded sparse checkout of the nixpkgs repository)
projects.versionAtPin: nixpkgs master at the pin (no tag claimed)
projects.buildConfig: sparse checkout; never evaluated; pkgs/ is deliberately absent

scanRoots.why: PAM, sudo/doas, wrappers, auditing: privilege-sensitive modules (36 files scanned)
HTTP server modules: scripts, certificates, secrets (41 files scanned)

projects.excluded: everything outside the two roots, including pkgs/ (not fetched), nixos/modules/services/networking/ssh (fetched but not scanned: kept for a future selection), and the cone-mode ancestor-level files (hundreds of unrelated services/networking modules that the sparse checkout materialises as a side effect and which are NOT in a scan root)

fixtures.note: Authored for this benchmark. Three services (HTTP api, queue worker, HTTP reporting) joined by an SQS-style queue and a MongoDB-style store.
